steps_basic.title: Backdrops
steps_basic.instruction: Stage → Backdrops. Create WAIT and GO backdrops with big text.

steps_basic.title: Start WAIT
steps_basic.instruction: Stage code: green flag → switch to WAIT.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]

steps_basic.title: Random wait
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds

steps_basic.title: Reset timer
steps_basic.instruction: Reset timer, then switch to GO.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_basic.title: Click to see time
steps_basic.instruction: Stage: when clicked, say timer for 2 seconds.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Best time variable
steps_standard.hint: High number so any time beats it
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)

steps_standard.title: State variable
steps_standard.instruction: Make 'state'. Set to WAIT at start and when backdrop switches.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [state v] to [WAIT]
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
set [state v] to [GO]
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_standard.title: Anti-cheat
steps_standard.instruction: When clicked: if state=WAIT say Too early, else show timer.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Update best
steps_standard.instruction: In else: if timer < bestTime, set bestTime to timer.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds
  if <(timer) < (bestTime)> then
    set [bestTime v] to (timer)

steps_advanced.title: Round variables
steps_advanced.instruction: Make 'round' and 'total'. Set both to 0 at start.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)

steps_advanced.title: 3-round loop
steps_advanced.instruction: Repeat 3: WAIT setup → random wait → GO → wait for click.
steps_advanced.hint: Control → repeat, wait until mouse down
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
repeat (3)
  set [state v] to [WAIT]
  switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
  wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
  reset timer
  set [state v] to [GO]
  switch backdrop to [GO v]
  wait until <mouse down?>
  change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Add to total
steps_advanced.instruction: After wait until, add timer to total.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
wait until <mouse down?>
change [total v] by (timer)
change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Show average
steps_advanced.instruction: After repeat: make 'average', set to total/3, say it.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
after repeat:
set [average v] to ((total) / (3))
say (join [Average: ] (average)) for (3) seconds
